name: @bossnyumba/learning-signal-emitter
description: Emits one LearningSignal per (action, outcome) pair: a pure reward model scores the outcome into [-1, 1], a per-power-tier isolation gate enforces user/org/platform boundaries (k-anonymity before any platform rollup), then the signal fans out to injected belief / reflexion / mastery / pattern / persona-prompt / preference sinks. Real-estate domain (leases, rent, maintenance, compliance) — the emitter never writes a belief directly; the belief sink owns that path. No DB/env/network: every side effect is an injected port.
